A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have computed all the four-point correlation functions in the N =1 chiral multiplet at order O ( g 4 ).
we have determined the two-loop anomalous dimension of all unprotected operators of the N =1 Konishi supermultiplets, which includes the two-loop contribution of the Konishi operator itself.
we have computed the four-point correlation functions for all operators in the N=4 supercurrent multiplets at order g 2, g3 and g 4.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the anomalous dimension is given by the logarithmic divergence of the four-point function of the Konishi superfield.

we have shown how to compute anomalous dimensions of composite operators in N =4 SYM theory using the superfield formalism, and we have demonstrated that this formalism is powerful enough to reproduce the results that were previously obtained using the superconformal bootstrap.
the supercurrent multiplet is a natural framework to study anomalous dimensions of operators of arbitrary R charge in the context of N =4 superconformal symmetry.
